description: A React hook (`useProgressiveExpand`) and utility (`createProgressiveExpandController`) that provide a mechanism to process large lists of items in batches, yielding control to the main thread using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, to prevent UI blocking during heavy operations.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, providing start and cancel capabilities, and progress callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that manages the state around the batch processing controller, providing UI-friendly progress updates and control functions.
